releases.name: Version 0.2.0
releases.body:
- Added more decoration to the Clubhouse, including new dialogue.
- Adjusted the achievements to be more consistent and added a new one.
- Adjusted some white hole positions.
- Other small tweaks.
releases.bodyZh:
- 为俱乐部屋添加了更多装饰，包括新的对话。
- 调整了成就，使其更加一致并添加了一个新的成就。
- 调整了一些白洞的位置。
- 其他一些小修改。
